Two AI plays I'm long that most people treat as unrelated:

$HIVE — a Bitcoin miner turning its data centers into GPU/AI compute.

Different layers. Same trend. That's the whole thesis. 🧵

text:
Why own BOTH $HIVE and Keel instead of picking one?

Because the AI buildout is a stack, not a single company:
- It repurposes power & data centers into GPU compute (compute layer)
- Keel is the data infrastructure underneath (foundation layer)

Owning the stack > betting on one layer.
